spec.name: sprint11_kalshi_polymarket_spread_measure
spec.hypothesis: Resolution-text-matched Kalshi/Polymarket binary contracts on the same event show measurable cross-venue price spreads net of venue fees, per documented ~$40M/yr extraction and 1.5-4.5% spreads (IMDEA study, cited BACKLOG priority 2).
spec.power_argument: T0 mechanism-check, never a verdict (charter cost-model section): goal is to measure spread frequency/size, not score a strategy. Provisional trade-spec power (for the FOLLOW-ON registered spec once matching is built): ~30-60 concurrently active matched pairs scanned every 5min over a 60-day validation window = ~43,200 scan-observations; even at 1-2% crossing-spread frequency (literature-implied) that is >400 events, clearing the n>=300 floor. Min detectable edge at t=2 (~150bps assumed per-event stdev, not a briefing fact) is ~17bps, well below the documented 150-450bps median spread.
spec.symbols: dynamic — nightly resolution-text-matched Kalshi/Polymarket pairs, no fixed universe
